virtual_guide_scripts.what_is_omni: Omni-Compass is supervisory software from Dubra Software Inc. / The Omni-Compass LLC. It observes native controllers, proposes permitted setting changes, and retains rollback. It does not replace the underlying hardware or pass user data through a new data plane.
virtual_guide_scripts.where_numbers_come_from: Every displayed number comes from a named paired-run receipt and scoring rule, with its version and evidence class. The software index is not a whole-system bill reduction. Physical meters, cloud billing and models are separate readings.
virtual_guide_scripts.what_is_measured: Useful completed work in the same interval, service latency, energy, resources and total bill are distinct metrics. Gains and adverse outcomes are reported under their own measurement definitions, not added together.
virtual_guide_scripts.licensing: Proposed commercial terms are a 25 percent share of contractually verified eligible savings and a separately negotiated 5 percent embedded-hardware royalty on an expressly agreed base. These are proposals, not measured benefits.

commercial_proposal.royalty_base: defined by signed agreement, not assumed gross hardware sales
commercial_proposal.savings_base: contractually verified attributable eligible net savings
commercial_proposal.additional_work_same_time: separately measure completed goodput per equal-duration interval
